verdict.rationale: Rippling's own product pages describe a natural-language interface for both questions and actions. Admins can ask about any device, threat or compliance gap and have AI automate remediations and build reports (docs-24). They can tell Rippling what they need so agents order, route, retrieve and retire devices (docs-30), and can ask Rippling AI anything across their data (docs-32). The evidence is marketing-level only, and the MCP server listing is not credited here because it belongs to a separate story. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the natural-language command interface (which actions are supported, how confirmation and permissions work), coverage of identity/access operations via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
